title: My Daughter Talked Slow and Loud Because She Thought I Was Deaf. I Was a Court Reporter 41 Years.
description:
My daughter leaned across my kitchen table and talked to me slow and loud, like I was a dog that couldn't hear. You can't hear, you can't drive, you can't think straight. Sign the papers, or you're in Briar Glen by Christmas.

She forgot one thing. For forty-one years I sat in the county courthouse and wrote down every word anybody said in front of me. I never stopped. Stay until her housewarming party, when somebody read her own words back to her.
